record.paper_title: The Strong Convergence of Subgradients of Convex Functions Along Directions: Perspectives and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Nearby perturbation and nearby direction question
record.original_question: Fix a direction w_0 and a tolerance ε > 0. For a given convex continuous function f and point x, can one find a nearby direction w with ||w_0 - w|| < ε and another convex continuous function g_ε such that |f(y) - f(x)| <= |g_ε(y) - g_ε(x)| + ε ||y - x|| for all y in X, and such that the directional subdifferential limit lim_{t↓0} ∂g_ε(x + t w) exists?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a real Banach space with norm $\|\cdot\|$, and let $f: X \to \mathbb{R}$ be a convex continuous function. For $x \in X$, denote by $\partial f(x) \subset X^*$ the (Fenchel–Moreau) subdifferential of $f$ at $x$, i.e. the set of $x^* \in X^*$ such that $f(y) \ge f(x) + \langle x^*, y - x\rangle$ for all $y \in X$.

Fix a point $x \in X$, a direction $w_0 \in X$, and a tolerance $\varepsilon > 0$. Determine whether there always exist a direction $w \in X$ with $\|w_0 - w\| < \varepsilon$ and a convex continuous function $g_\varepsilon : X \to \mathbb{R}$ such that:

(i) for all $y \in X$,
$$|f(y) - f(x)| \le |g_\varepsilon(y) - g_\varepsilon(x)| + \varepsilon\, \|y - x\|;$$

(ii) the directional limit
$$\lim_{t \downarrow 0} \partial g_\varepsilon(x + t w)$$
exists (in an appropriate strong sense, e.g. each net of selections $x^*_t \in \partial g_\varepsilon(x + tw)$ converges in norm of $X^*$ as $t \downarrow 0$).
artifact.status_search_result: The question belongs to a family of problems (originating with Giannessi) on directional strong convergence of subgradients of convex functions. The general infinite-dimensional theory is not developed, and this specific perturbation question is posed as an open problem; no subsequent resolution was located in the available literature.

status_evidence.title: The Strong Convergence of Subgradients of Convex Functions Along Directions: Perspectives and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of perspectives and open problems on directional strong convergence of subgradients of convex functions.
status_evidence.claim: The nearby-direction/nearby-function question is posed as an open problem in this survey.

status_evidence.title: On the Strong Convergence of Subgradients of Convex Functions
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates relative compactness of unions of subdifferentials along a direction in connection with directional strong convergence.
status_evidence.claim: Recent works treat related strong-convergence questions but do not settle the perturbation problem.
